text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Hey, you! You're it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I stop by the gymnasium during my lunch
break
where I'm cornered by Twin Turbo.
I ask her what
she's doing.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I've been super hooked on Dash Tag
lately!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Dash Tag is an online game based on
traditional
tag. It seems that Twin Turbo
has been playing it
every day via the
academy's VR Umalator.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
If you're "it," then you better daaash!
And if
you're a "runner," you've gotta
zoom away!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
According to her explanation, the rules
are based
on regular tag, where the one
tagged "it" chases
down the runner.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
And once you've fully charged your
gauge, you
can pull off something really
cool and awesome!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's only usable once per game, but after
fully
charging your energy gauge, you
can unleash a
special move which lets
you jump or accelerate
rapidly.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
And if you don't get caught for five
whole
minutes, you win!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I want to practice being a runner, so
you're it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This game incorporates our actual
physical
capabilities, and as a regular
human, the chances
of catching an
Umamusume are slim to none.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat?! No fair! You've gotta help me
practice!
I wanna be the best again!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh! I was unbeatable when I was a
kid! I
played aaall the time with the VR
set we had at
home!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I had an online friend called TSUBAME,
and we'd
hunt 'em all down, like BAM!
We were the dream
team!

text_block_list.name: TSUBAME
text_block_list.text:
All right, I'll hunt 'em down, so I need
you
guarding my rear, Turbo!

text_block_list.name: Young Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Hey, who made you boss?! I'm gonna
charge in
there and lay the smackdown!
Let's go, go, go!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, I logged back in and started
playing
again for the first time in ages!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
But... I couldn't win a single match! Not
even one!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo works herself up into
another
tantrum, and I'm left at a
complete loss as to how
to pacify her.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hey, that sounds kinda fun! Care to take
me on?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so begins a game of Dash Tag with
Twin
Turbo versus Tokai Teio!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Over here, silly! You can't
catch meee!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But as time goes on...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff! Wheeze! Just... one more minute... to go!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh! There you are, Double Jet!
Be a
good girl and give up already!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Grrr! Neveeer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That's when I notice Twin Turbo's gauge
is fully
charged! If she uses her special
move now, her
escape should be all but
guaranteed. However...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: I gotta boost away! But how?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If I remind her about the special move,
she's got a
good chance of winning. But
it might be better
for her to learn things
the hard way! What to do...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Special... move?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: OH!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Wait, you're right! You're right! Yippee,
time to
unleash my super jump!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: What the?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo shoots through the
storehouse's roof,
escaping into the blue
sky above. And then...

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: Game over. The runner wins!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: I DID IT!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh! I'm super skilled, what can I
say!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I nearly had you! ...Not to mention, a certain someone gave you a hint about the special move!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Regardless of any objections, Twin
Turbo
continues to be in high spirits
long after her
victory.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Special... move?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: You're right! It's all charged up!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Um, okay, I just have to unleash the skill
and...
Wait, what button was it again?!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! That's not it! This one?! Wrong,
wrong,
wrong! Why isn't anything
woooorking?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Geez, what's the matter with you?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaah! Just gimme a second, you
dummy!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Nope! I win!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: GAAAAAHHHHH!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Sniffle... No fair. I wanna win...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: I WANNA WIN!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
No way! You still have the energy to
run?!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Gack!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: But not enough to get away, it seems!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo is easily captured, and the
game ends
in her defeat.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Waaaaah! No fair, no faaaair!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...You know, I was surprised at how you
kept
trying to run despite being so worn
out. That was
pretty cool of you!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh! Yeah, well, I'm always cool!
